notes: Counts are statements extracted from each review, comment or page and grouped by theme. They are not a poll, a rating or a failure rate.
Retailer reviews are seller-collected and skew positive. Where a retailer listing was sampled, the page's own totals are shown above.
Reddit and forum posts are self-selected, and many are people asking for help, so problems are over-represented.
Themes were tagged by a model and the quotes behind them were machine-checked against the source text. Examples link to the original post.
Amazon's 4.4 from about 11,960 ratings is shared by the grey, black and Sterling listings of the 4432, so it is not specific to one colour.
ownerNote: Read the problem counts below with care. Reddit threads about this machine are mostly people asking for help, so problems are over-represented. The retailers' own ratings under 'How we collected this' are the better gauge of overall satisfaction.

Heavy Duty 4423.summary: Singer lists the 4423 with 23 built-in stitches and 97 stitch applications against the 4432's 32 and 110.
MSRP $289.99 for the 4423 against $299.99 for the 4432.

Heavy Duty 4411.summary: The 4411 has 11 built-in stitches and 69 stitch applications against 32 and 110 on the 4432.
The 4411 has a four-step buttonhole; the 4432 has a one-step buttonhole.
No built-in needle threader is listed for the 4411; the 4432 has one.

Heavy Duty 4452.summary: Singer lists the same 32 built-in stitches and 110 stitch applications for the 4452. Some Reddit commenters say the 4452 has more stitches; Singer's pages do not support that.
The 4452 adds a walking foot, non-stick foot, clearance plate and heavy duty needles ($120 of accessories per Singer); MSRP $319.99 against $299.99. Commenters describe the difference the same way.
